get.description: Set the CSRF cookie. The frontend calls this before the login.

patch.description:
Change the language or the timezone of the signed-in user. An empty timezone means the
timezone of the browser.

post.description: Set the picture of the signed-in user. Only a PNG or a JPEG of at most 2 MB.

get.description: The picture of a user. Every signed-in user can see it, like the names.

put.description: Set the cars of the class from today. Old rows stay in the history.

get.description: The track and car folders of the catalog, for tools/pack_game_images.py.
Career points are the official points of all seasons.

post.description: Link a driver profile to an account, or remove the link with user_id null.
Move everything of this profile to another profile of the same person, then delete it.

put.description: Add a user to the championship, or change the role of a member.

post.description: Reserve a fixed track before the track voting. Position and date are optional.

patch.description: Set the calendar position or the date of a round.

post.description: Put another track on a calendar round. A round with a result keeps its track.

A new season with the entries, the current rules, and the fixed tracks of this one.
The fixed rounds keep their number and track, with no date.

get.description: The lines of an old version. Old versions stay for the history.

post.description: Mark one driver as DNF with one click. The result gets a new version.

put.description: Enter or correct the race classification. Each save makes a new version.

get.description: The file of a piece of evidence. Only members of the championship see it.
League admins see every entry. A championship admin sees the entries of that championship.

post.description: Upload a result file. The same file again gives the stored import and adds nothing.
Upload one or more Real Penalty logs. A file that the round already has adds nothing.
Start a runoff. The answer is the new runoff ballot.

get.description: The search box in the header. It needs two letters or more.
What waits for this admin. A user who manages nothing gets an empty list.
How much data each tab of the round page has.

post.description: A new one-time link, for a forgotten password. Older links stop working.

The health of the collector, every 5 minutes: the files that wait, the last error, and
the Content Manager presets.

get.description: The newest program, for the update of a collector.

post.description:
"Descargar colector": a zip with the program and a collector.ini with this key. The app
keeps only a hash of the key, so the admin sends the key back (it shows one time only).

get.description: All rounds of the championships that the owner of the token can see.
What "Enviar al servidor" would write, and the state of the last push.

post.description: The Content Manager presets of the server, for the list in "Enviar al servidor".

get.description: The push that waits for the collector, or nothing.
